description: Today, undocumented students who attend and graduate from Massachusetts high schools must pay out-of-state tuition to attend our public colleges and universities. These are our students, and Massachusetts is their home. It’s past time to give them access to in-state tuition. This session, I filed a bill to make in-state tuition available to undocumented students …
title: Tuition Equity for Students in Massachusetts | Adrian Madaro | Adrian Madaro
